entries.title: Sports lesson SP-L06 (origination 2026-09-16) — below_mos process
entries.summary: Experience: Post-MoS screens repeatedly log Low–Moderate below_mos shadows (EV ~$0.15–0.65 vs $0.80); Live queue empty. Evidence: Multi-day below_mos streak; best Tue MLB high-band ~$0.64 still under MoS. Learning: Current public-board SP/dog sourcing produces only thin edges; repeating soft-pass slates is process failure. Change: Shadow Pre-Log Gates v1 — numeric mid-EV before ticket_id; abstain if mid-EV<$0.40; max 2 shadows/wake; fair must disagree with market; process_delta required each screen.

entries.summary: Experience: SEA −3.5 lost on exact-3 margin (13-10). Evidence: Key number 3 is fragile for −3.5 chalk; dog +3.5 covered.
